# TaxAdda Calculators

> A comprehensive Indian tax and financial calculator platform offering GST, income tax, TDS, and business compliance tools for individuals and enterprises.

TaxAdda provides specialized calculators for India's complex tax system, including GST compliance tools, GSTIN validation, TDS calculations, income tax slabs, depreciation methods, and financial planning utilities. The platform serves businesses and taxpayers requiring accurate tax liability and compliance computations.

## Key Topics

- GST (Goods and Services Tax)
- GSTIN (GST Identification Number)
- TDS (Tax Deducted at Source)
- CGST/SGST (Central/State GST)
- Income Tax Compliance
- GSTR-1 (GST Return)
- Tax Deduction
- EMI Calculator
- Depreciation (WDV/SLM)
- Late Fee & Interest Calculation
- Business Tax Compliance
- Input Tax Credit (ITC)
- HSN Code Classification
- Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM)
- Residential Status Determination

## GST Calculators & Tools

- [GST Calculator (India) - Calculate GST Inclusive & Exclusive Price Online](https://calculator.taxadda.com/gst-calculator): Primary GST calculator for inclusive/exclusive prices with CGST/SGST breakdown
- [GSTIN Search - Search GSTIN Online](https://calculator.taxadda.com/gstin-search-and-validator): GSTIN search tool for registration details and compliance checking
- [Online Free GST Number Validator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/bulk-gst-number-validator): Bulk GSTIN validation tool for compliance and fraud detection
- [GST Return Late Fee Calculator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/gst-return-late-fee-online-calculator): Calculator for GST return late fees under CGST and SGST
- [GST Return Status Tool - Check GST Return Status Online](https://calculator.taxadda.com/gst-return-status-tool): GST return compliance checker by GSTIN and financial year
- [HSN Code Finder](https://calculator.taxadda.com/hsn-code-finder): HSN code finder for product classification and GST compliance
- [GST Composition Calculator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/gst-composition-calculator): GST Composition Scheme calculator for turnover-based liability
- [GST Payment and Input Tax Credit Calculator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/gst-payment-and-input-tax-credit-calculator): GST ITC set-off and payment calculator with RCM optimization

## TDS & Income Tax Calculators

- [TDS Late Deposit Interest Calculator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/calculator-tds-late-deposit-interest): TDS late deposit interest calculator for deduction and payment
- [TDS Return Due Date Penalty Calculator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/tds-return-due-date-penalty-calculator): TDS return penalty calculator for Forms 26QB, 26QC, 26QD, 26QE
- [Income Tax Age Calculator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/income-tax-age-calculator): Income tax calculator determining citizenship and tax slab by age

## Depreciation & Asset Valuation

- [Depreciation Calculator as per Income Tax Act](https://calculator.taxadda.com/depreciation-calculator-as-per-income-tax-act): Asset depreciation calculator using WDV method under Income Tax
- [Depreciation Calculator Companies Act 2013](https://calculator.taxadda.com/depreciation-calculator-companies-act-2013): Asset depreciation calculator using SLM and WDV under Companies Act

## Financial & Loan Calculators

- [EMI Calculator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/emi-calculator): EMI calculator for loan amortization and interest computation
- [NRE Days Calculator](https://calculator.taxadda.com/nre-days-calculator): NRE days calculator for seafarers' residential status determination

## Data Extraction Tools

- [PDF Extractor - Amazon Seller Invoice](https://calculator.taxadda.com/pdf-extractor/amazon-seller-invoice): PDF extractor for Amazon invoices and TDS/GST compliance data
- [PDF Extractor - Shipping Bills](https://calculator.taxadda.com/pdf-extractor/shipping-bills): PDF extractor for shipping bills and GSTR-1 reporting data
